newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares slide in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares slide in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares slid in light trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
The group A index, which has been easing steadily since a bull run in January, fell by 80.49 points to 2,566.55 in trade of only 925,000 litas.
Birzai Dairy, one of the leading blue chip listings, dipped by 9.79 percent to 8.75 litas after its unaudited 1996 results fell below market expectations.
"Birzai's profits were considerably less than expected," one dealer told Reuters.
The company said earlier in an unaudited statement that it made a net profit of 1.89 million litas in 1996 versus 3.85 million litas in 1995.
Rokishkis Cheese rose on the strength of its unaudited reults, which were better than market expectations, showing a net profit of 12.19 million litas versus 9.32 million litas.
Its shares rose to 49.00 litas from 45.00 in trade of 21,805 litas.
But most shares eased or held steady.
"January's bull run was partly speculative, especially with some of the smaller companies, and those shares are now falling," one dealer told Reuters.
The secondary T-bill market soared on Wednesday to over 16 million litas because a couple of banks required capital, dealers said.
The volume of block trades was only 124,000 litas.
